headline: PPL (PPL) Stock Looks Fairly Valued On Data Center Power Plant Plans
summary: PPL stock has delivered a solid 49.3% total return over the past three years, yet its broader valuation checks currently lean more on the expensive side rather than as a clear bargain. Over the last three years, PPL has returned 49.3%, which puts recent short term share price softness into the context of a strong medium term run.
